bugs_fixed.bug: AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'get' — get_current_user() returns a userId string, but code called user.get('userId')
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to: user_id = await get_current_user(authorization); directly use user_id string

critical_code_review_comments: Delete account bug fixed: get_current_user returns str (userId), not dict. Was calling .get() on string.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 29 smoke test items PASS. Fixed delete-account 500 error. App is handoff-ready.
rca_of_issue: DELETE /api/auth/delete-account returned 500: get_current_user() in middleware.py returns payload['userId'] (a string), but auth.py delete_account() called user.get('userId') treating it as a dict. Fixed by using the return value directly as user_id.
